DirXMLScript_DTD_Elements.description: Defines the structure for policies, rules, conditions, actions, arguments, and tokens used in processing XDS documents.

policy.description: Top-level container for an ordered set of rules, used to examine and modify an XDS document.

rule.description: A fundamental building block specifying a set of conditions and actions.

conditions.description: Defines criteria (CNF or DNF) that must be met for actions to be performed.

actions.description: The operations (<do-*>) performed when conditions are met.

do-for-each.description: For-each loop over a node set.

examples:
<do-if>
<arg-conditions>
<and>
<if-op-attr mode="nocase" name="Given Name" op="equal">fred</if-op-attr>
</and>
</arg-conditions>
<arg-actions>
<do-add-dest-attr-value name="Surname">
<arg-value type="string">
<token-text>Flintstone</token-text>
</arg-value>
</do-add-dest-attr-value>
</arg-actions>
<arg-actions>
<do-add-dest-attr-value name="Surname">
<arg-value type="string">
<token-text>Rubble</token-text>
</arg-value>
</do-add-dest-attr-value>
</arg-actions>
</do-if>

<do-set-local-variable name="counter">
<arg-string>
<token-text>1</token-text>
</arg-string>
</do-set-local-variable>

<do-while>
<arg-conditions>
<and>
<if-local-variable mode="numeric" name="counter" op="not-gt">10</if-local-variable>
</and>
</arg-conditions>
<arg-actions>
<do-trace-message color="yellow" level="0">
<arg-string>
<token-text>Counter = </token-text>
<token-local-variable name="counter"/>
</arg-string>
</do-trace-message>
<do-set-local-variable name="counter">
<arg-string>
<token-xpath expression="$counter + 1"/>
</arg-string>
</do-set-local-variable>
</arg-actions>
</do-while>

<policy>
<description>My policy</description>
<include name="..\..\Library\My shared policy"/>
<rule>
<description>Rule to disallow moving a user</description>
<comment>This rule was added because under no circumsances do we ever want to perform a move.</comment>
<conditions>
<and>
<if-class-name mode="nocase" op="equal">User</if-class-name>
<if-operation op="equal">move</if-operation>
</and>
</conditions>
<actions>
<veto/>
</actions>
</rule>
<rule>
<description>Rule to disallow operations on a disabled user or group</description>
<conditions>
<or>
<if-class-name mode="nocase" op="equal">User</if-class-name>
<if-class-name mode="nocase" op="equal">Group</if-class-name>
</or>
<or>
<if-attr mode="nocase" name="Login Disabled" op="equal">true</if-attr>
</or>
</conditions>
<actions>
<veto/>
</actions>
</rule>
</policy>

Argument_Elements.description: Elements defining dynamic input data for Actions.

arg-actions.description: Specifies actions associated with the enclosing action (e.g., do-if, do-while). Contains <do-*> elements.

arg-conditions.description: Specifies conditions associated with the enclosing action (e.g., do-if, do-while). Contains <and> or <or> elements.

arg-dn.description: DN argument. Concatenates enclosed tokens to form a DN value.

arg-node-set.description: Node set argument. Specifies an XPATH 1.0 node-set.

arg-query-condition.description: Query condition argument. Specifies a logical conditional search expression.
examples:
<arg-query-condition name="and">
	<arg-match-attr name="Surname"/>
	<arg-query-condition name="or">
		<arg-match-attr name="OU"/>
		<arg-query-condition name="not">
			<arg-match-attr name="Title">
				<arg-value type="string">
					<token-text xml:space="preserve">SSE</token-text>
				</arg-value>
			</arg-match-attr>
		</arg-query-condition>
	</arg-query-condition>
</arg-query-condition>

arg-string.description: String argument. Concatenates enclosed tokens to form a string value.

arg-value.description: Value argument. Specifies an attribute value.
examples:
<arg-value>
<token-attr name="Surname"/>
<token-text>, </token-text>
<token-attr name="Given Name"/>
</arg-value>

<arg-value type="structured">
<arg-component name="string">
<token-text>EN</token-text>
</arg-component>
<arg-component name="string">
<token-text>JP</token-text>
</arg-component>
</arg-value>

Token_Elements.description: Dynamic values expanded at run-time (45+ types listed).

token-added-entitlement.description: Granted entitlement value(s) in the current operation.

token-association.description: Association value from the current operation.

token-attr.description: Attribute value(s) in the current operation or source datastore (union of op-attr and src-attr).

token-base64-decode.description: Decode base64 data into a string.

token-base64-encode.description: Encode a string into base64 data.

token-class-name.description: Object class name from the current operation.

token-convert-time.description: Convert a date/time from one format to another.
examples:
<token-convert-time dest-format="dd/MM/YYYY" dest-lang="en-US" dest-tz="MST" src-format="MM/dd/YYYY" src-lang="en-US" src-tz="MST" offset="4" offset-unit="day">
<token-op-attr name="birthdate"/>
</token-convert-time>

token-dest-attr.description: Attribute value(s) of current object in the destination datastore.

token-dest-dn.description: Value derived from the destination DN.

token-dest-name.description: Unqualified RDN derived from destination DN.

token-entitlement.description: Value(s) of a granted entitlement of the current object.

token-escape-for-dest-dn.description: Convert a string for use in a destination DN.

token-escape-for-src-dn.description: Convert a string for use in a source DN.

token-join.description: Join a node-set into a string.

examples:
<token-json-object>
	<arg-string name="name">
		<token-text xml:space="preserve">"Mike"</token-text>
	</arg-string>
	<arg-string name="age">
		<token-text xml:space="preserve">40</token-text>
	</arg-string>
	<arg-string name="disabled">
		<token-text xml:space="preserve">false</token-text>
	</arg-string>
	<arg-string name="rights">
		<token-json-array>
			<arg-string>
				<token-text xml:space="preserve">"admin"</token-text>
			</arg-string>
			<arg-string>
				<token-text xml:space="preserve">"manager"</token-text>
			</arg-string>
			<arg-string>
				<token-text xml:space="preserve">"reviewer"</token-text>
			</arg-string>
		</token-json-array>
	</arg-string>
</token-json-object>

token-lower-case.description: Convert a string to lower case.

token-map.description: Map a string through a mapping table.
examples:
<token-map dest="resourceDN" source="entitlementName" table="..\EntitlementLLIDMapping" type="AND">
<token-local-variable="entName"/>
<token-map-source-col name="LLID">
<token-local-variable name="_llid_"/>
</token-map-source-col>
</token-map>

token-map-source-col.description: Used in token-map to have multiple source columns.

token-op-attr.description: Value(s) of an attribute only in the current operation.

examples:
<token-parse-dn dest-dn-format="dest-dn" length="-1" src-dn-format="src-dn" start="0">
<token-op-attr name="Group Membership"/>
</token-parse-dn>

token-password.description: Value of the password in current operation.

token-query.description: Query the source or destination datastore.
examples:
<token-query class-name="User" datastore="dest" scope="subordinates">
<arg-dn>
	<token-text>Users/</token-text>
	<token-attr name="OU"/>
</arg-dn>
<arg-match-attr name="CN"/>
<arg-match-attr name="Title"/>
<arg-query-condition name="or">
	<arg-match-attr name="L">
	  <arg-value>
		<token-text>Provo</token-text>
	  </arg-value>
	</arg-match-attr>
	<arg-match-attr name="L">
	  <arg-value>
		<token-text>Bangalore</token-text>
	  </arg-value>
	</arg-match-attr>
</arg-query-condition>
<arg-string>
	<token-text>Surname</token-text>
</arg-string>
<arg-string>
	<token-text>Given Name</token-text>
</arg-string>
</token-query>

token-removed-attr.description: Value(s) of an attribute removed in the current operation.

token-removed-entitlement.description: Value(s) of an entitlement revoked in the current operation.

token-replace-all.description: Replace all instances of a substring within a string.

token-replace-first.description: Replace a single instance of a substring within a string.

token-resolve.description: Resolve a DN to an association key or vice versa.

token-split.description: Split a string into a node-set.

token-src-attr.description: Value(s) of an attribute only in the source datastore.

token-src-dn.description: Value derived from the source DN.

token-src-name.description: Unqualified RDN derived from source DN.

examples:
<token-unique-name counter-digits="2" counter-pad="true" counter-pattern="first" counter-start="1" counter-use="fallback" name="CN" on-unavailable="error" scope="subtree" test-all-objects="true">
<arg-string>
<token-upper-case>
<token-substring length="1" start="0">
<token-attr name="Given Name"/>
</token-substring>
<token-attr name="Surname"/>
</token-upper-case>
</arg-string>
<arg-string>
<token-upper-case>
<token-substring length="1" start="0">
<token-attr name="Given Name"/>
</token-substring>
<token-substring length="1" start="0">
<token-attr name="MI"/>
</token-substring>
<token-attr name="Surname"/>
</token-upper-case>
</arg-string>
<arg-string>
<token-upper-case>
<token-attr name="Given Name"/>
<token-attr name="Surname"/>
</token-upper-case>
</arg-string>
</token-unique-name>

token-unmatched-src-dn.description: A DN relative to the one matched by if-src-dn.

token-upper-case.description: Convert a string to upper case.

token-xml-parse.description: Parse XML. Returns a document node in a node-set.

token-xml-serialize.description: Serialize a node-set result as XML.

token-xpath.description: Result of evaluating an XPATH 1.0 expression.
